pumi.controlplane.v1.GetWorkflowResponse.description: GetWorkflowResponse is the response of GetWorkflow.
pumi.controlplane.v1.GetWorkflowResponse.title: Get Workflow Response

pumi.workflow.v1.Final.jsonschema.json.description: Final is an entry that finishes the plan.

merged.description:
Whether the plan has merged when it is in this state. A plan that
 depends on another starts only when that plan is in a final state that
 has merged (decision 0197).

pumi.workflow.v1.Final.jsonschema.json.title: Final

pumi.workflow.v1.Invoke.jsonschema.json.description: Invoke is an entry that starts an invocation (decision 0168).

^(model_role)$.description:
The model role of an agent run, such as "implementer", which the
 configuration maps to a model and a fallback model at the model
 gateway. A state that starts a harness names one; a state that starts
 a check or an external action names none (decision 0233).

^(output_message)$.description:
The full name of the protobuf message in the api module that the
 invocation's structured output must be, such as
 pumi.workflow.v1.PlanningOutput (decision 0160).

^(returns_tree)$.description:
Whether the result of a check carries the workspace's tree, as the
 archive step's does (decisions 0278 and 0282). The runner drops the
 file changes of a check without it. Only a state that starts a check
 may set it.

component.description:
The component name of a check, such as "spec", by which the
 configuration names the check's program (decision 0272). A state that
 starts a check names one; a state that starts a harness or an external
 action names none.

modelRole.description:
The model role of an agent run, such as "implementer", which the
 configuration maps to a model and a fallback model at the model
 gateway. A state that starts a harness names one; a state that starts
 a check or an external action names none (decision 0233).

outputMessage.description:
The full name of the protobuf message in the api module that the
 invocation's structured output must be, such as
 pumi.workflow.v1.PlanningOutput (decision 0160).

returnsTree.description:
Whether the result of a check carries the workspace's tree, as the
 archive step's does (decisions 0278 and 0282). The runner drops the
 file changes of a check without it. Only a state that starts a check
 may set it.

task.description:
The id of the task, such as "plan" or "review-plan". The task's text is
 its own file beside the workflow file.

pumi.workflow.v1.Invoke.jsonschema.json.title: Invoke

pumi.workflow.v1.State.jsonschema.json.description: State is one state of the workflow (decision 0168).

gate.description:
The gate of the state, or empty. The attempts fact is counted per plan
 and gate each time the plan enters the state (decision 0136).

name.description: The name, unique in the workflow.

parent.description:
The name of the state's parent, its superstate, or empty. A transition
 of a superstate fires from each of its substates (decision 0170).

transitions.description:
The transitions, in order. For a trigger, the kernel asks the control
 plane about each transition of that trigger in this order and fires the
 first one allowed (decision 0169).

wait.description: Start nothing, and wait for an event.

pumi.workflow.v1.State.jsonschema.json.title: State

pumi.workflow.v1.Transition.jsonschema.j.description: Transition is one transition of a state (decision 0168).

action.description:
The name of the Cedar action that guards the transition, as
 pumi.cedarschema declares it, such as "advance" or "retry".

target.description: The name of the state the transition goes to.

pumi.workflow.v1.Transition.jsonschema.j.title: Transition

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationCapRe.description:
InvocationCapReached fires on the invocation.finished event of the
 invocation that the state started when its outcome is cap reached,
 instead of InvocationResult (decision 0203). Every state that starts an
 invocation declares it.
pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationCapRe.title: Invocation Cap Reached

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationFaile.description:
InvocationFailed fires on the invocation.finished event of the
 invocation that the state started when its outcome is failed, instead
 of InvocationResult (decision 0235). Every state that starts an
 invocation declares it.
pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationFaile.title: Invocation Failed

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationInDou.description:
InvocationInDoubt fires when the invocation that the state started is
 in doubt: its last lease ended with no result (decisions 0199 and 0200).
 A state that starts an agent run or an external action declares it; a
 check in doubt runs again, so a state that starts one does not.
pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationInDou.title: Invocation In Doubt

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationResul.description:
InvocationResult fires on the invocation.finished event of the
 invocation that the state started when its outcome is succeeded, or
 resolved on recovery for an external action that happened (decisions
 0202 and 0235).
pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.InvocationResul.title: Invocation Result

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.StateEntered.js.description:
StateEntered fires as the state is entered, for a state that only
 decides.
pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.StateEntered.js.title: State Entered

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.jsonschema.json.description:
Trigger is what fires a transition (decision 0170): exactly one of these.
 The kernel reads triggers from Subscribe in log order, and each event
 fires at most once.

^(cap_reached)$.description:
The state's invocation reached a cap of its budget: its wall-time
 limit, or its token or cost cap at the model gateway.

^(in_doubt)$.description: The state's invocation is in doubt.

capReached.description:
The state's invocation reached a cap of its budget: its wall-time
 limit, or its token or cost cap at the model gateway.

event.description:
An event whose subject is the plan, by its CloudEvents type, such as
 "dev.getpumi.approval.recorded" (decision 0135).

inDoubt.description: The state's invocation is in doubt.

result.description: The result of the state's invocation.

pumi.workflow.v1.Trigger.jsonschema.json.title: Trigger

pumi.workflow.v1.Wait.jsonschema.json.description: Wait is an entry that starts nothing: the state waits for an event.
pumi.workflow.v1.Wait.jsonschema.json.title: Wait

pumi.workflow.v1.Workflow.jsonschema.jso.description:
Workflow is the workflow: the states a plan moves through from spec to
 merge (decision 0168).

initial.description: The name of the initial state.

version.description:
The version. The workflow is pinned with the kernel version, and a plan
 finishes on the workflow it started with (decision 0166).

pumi.workflow.v1.Workflow.jsonschema.jso.title: Workflow
